collection.title: Ford Fiesta 2012 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a 2012 to 2017 version of the Ford Fiesta Hatchback which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Fiesta which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
